blocking: Hero video weight: hero-1080.mp4 is 30.9 MB and hero-720.mp4 is 12.1 MB, and the `media` attribute on <video><source> is ignored by Chrome/Edge/Firefox, so phones download the 31 MB 1080 file. Must re-encode (target ≤4 MB desktop, ≤2 MB phone, 10–15 s loop, CRF 28–30, no audio track) and pick the source in JS.

With motion on, the page has no accessible <h1>: site.js adds .is-built which sets .hero__word to visibility:hidden (removed from the accessibility tree) and the morph layer is aria-hidden. Screen readers and SEO get no h1 on the home page.

fixes.what: Replace the two <source media> tags with one <source> whose src is chosen in JS: `var src = matchMedia('(min-width:901px)').matches ? 'hero-1080.mp4' : 'hero-720.mp4'`; set heroVideo.src then .load(). Re-encode both files (ffmpeg -c:v libx264 -crf 29 -preset slow -an -movflags +faststart, trim loop to ~12 s) so 1080 ≤ 4 MB and 720 ≤ 2 MB. Add `fetchpriority="high"` to the poster via <link rel=preload as=image>.
fixes.why: source[media] is dead in every major browser except old Safari; today every phone pulls 31 MB on first paint.

fixes.what: Use an absolute URL: `https://anarevents.com/assets/video/hero-poster.jpg`, and add `<link rel="canonical">` plus og:url. Same on weddings.html (add og tags there; it has none).
fixes.why: Open Graph scrapers (iMessage, WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, which is how families share this) reject relative og:image, so link previews show no picture.

fixes.what: Keep the vertical list up to 1023px and switch to the 9-column line only at `@media (min-width:1024px)`; at 1024+ add `overflow-wrap:anywhere` on .journey__en. Move the --h/--v line toggles to the same breakpoint.
fixes.why: At 768–900px each column is ~65px; 'Consultation' and 'Khastegari' at 16px bold overflow into neighbouring stops (iPad portrait).

Mark required fields in the label (`Your names (required)`), add `aria-describedby` for the names placeholder hint, add a `

fixes.what: Export the branch, cloud, canopy and ground WebPs at 1400px wide (they render at ≤520px for branches, ≤1440px for bands) with `srcset`/`sizes`, add `decoding="async"` and `loading="lazy"` to the two hero clouds, and add `<link rel="preconnect">` for cdnjs.cloudflare.com and unpkg.com (or self-host gsap/lenis).
fixes.why: 1.65 MB of 2752px art ships for 220–520px slots and competes with the video on first load; the two script CDNs add two cold TLS handshakes before any motion can start.
